golden_policy.zh: 不预填完整模型 golden。普通文本只检查实际返回、可读性与请求关联；重复场景比较同次测试实际采集的 token。
golden_policy.en: No full-model golden is invented. Record actual outputs, assess request relevance, and compare tokens captured within the same repeat test.

prompts.text: Explain the difference between an FPGA and a CPU.

expectation.zh: 两次独立请求正常返回；第二次回答应关联 FPGA 与 CPU。不同提示词无需 token 相同。
expectation.en: Both independent requests return; the second response addresses FPGA versus CPU. Different prompts are not expected to produce identical tokens.

expectation.zh: 相同输入、配置和贪心解码下，两轮实际输出逐 token 比较；若不同保留两轮结果，不覆盖第一轮日志。
expectation.en: Compare the two actual outputs token by token with the same input, configuration and greedy decoding. Preserve both results if they diverge.

scenarios.system_prompt: 请使用用户提问所用的语言回答。 Answer in the language used by the user.
turns: Summarize your explanation in one English sentence.

expectation.zh: 记录多轮模板和实际输入 token 数；UTF-8 输入输出正常，不预设固定译文。
expectation.en: Record the chat template and actual input token count; confirm UTF-8 input/output without assuming a fixed translation.

counting_notes.zh: 必须按 tokenizer/chat template 后的实际 token ID 数计数，包含系统提示和历史，不能用字符数替代。最后一个生成 token 无需作为下一输入回送。
counting_notes.en: Count actual token IDs after tokenization/chat templating, including system and history. Character count is insufficient; the final generated token need not be resubmitted.

execution_notes.zh: 先运行短文本与同进程重复，再逐步测试跨1024/4096位置及近8192边界。接受边界只说明调度预算合法；仍需记录真实板卡返回、超时、寄存器与输出，不把参数检查通过当作长上下文推理通过。1024项目跳过此场景。
execution_notes.en: Run short text and repeat tests first, then cross 1024/4096 positions and approach 8192. Admission only proves a valid input budget; actual board output, timeouts and registers remain to be checked. Skip this scenario for 1024-context projects.

historical_bos_note.zh: BOS-only [128000] 的历史重复测试有失败证据，保留为独立诊断，不作为默认日常文本测试。
historical_bos_note.en: Historical BOS-only [128000] repeat failures remain separate diagnostic evidence; this is not the default everyday text test.
